grabby_capture_1.text: Mine! I'll take that, thank you.

thinkle_host_capture_queen_4.text: Gracious me, a queen! I must sit down.

thinkle_host_castling_1.text: Castling! It takes a king and a rook on the dice.

thinkle_host_castling_2.text: The king steps aside, and his tower leaps over!

thinkle_host_castling_3.text: One move for two pieces! That is castling.

thinkle_host_draw_1.text: Equals part as friends, as the old saying goes.

thinkle_host_draw_2.text: Neither side wins. What a gentle ending!

thinkle_host_draw_3.text: Level to the last! The stars applaud you both.

thinkle_host_draw_4.text: A draw, my friends. A tale with no victor today.

thinkle_host_draw_5.text: Neither side takes the game. My thanks to you both.

thinkle_host_draw_6.text: All square at the ending. Let us close the book together.

thinkle_host_empty_roll_1.text: Hmm... not a single move on that roll.

thinkle_host_empty_roll_2.text: A roll with no move. It happens to us all!

thinkle_host_empty_roll_3.text: Blame the dice, my friends, not the player!

thinkle_host_empty_roll_4.text: The dice kept their secrets this time.

thinkle_host_empty_roll_5.text: Even magic can't argue with the dice!

thinkle_host_en_passant_1.text: From my oldest scrolls: the rule of en passant!

thinkle_host_en_passant_2.text: A pawn's secret move! En passant, they call it.

thinkle_host_en_passant_3.text: En passant! Rarer than a blue moon.

thinkle_host_handoff_1.text: The remote passes on, my friends. Black's turn.

thinkle_host_handoff_2.text: Hear ye, hear ye! The remote goes to Black.

thinkle_host_handoff_3.text: Pass the wand! I mean... the remote. Black's turn.

thinkle_host_intro_1.text: Hmm... the dice favour no one, young or old.

thinkle_host_intro_10.text: A game begins with two willing players. Here you are!

thinkle_host_intro_2.text: Settle in, my friends. A new tale begins.

thinkle_host_intro_3.text: White, you roll first. The stars are watching!

thinkle_host_intro_4.text: Welcome, you two! May the best roll win.

thinkle_host_intro_5.text: I promise: no spells from me, only dice!

thinkle_host_intro_6.text: Two players, a fresh board, and a story yet to tell.

thinkle_host_intro_7.text: My spells are put away, my friends. This game is yours.

thinkle_host_intro_8.text: Gather round, you two. Let the dice open our story.

thinkle_host_intro_9.text: My hat is on, my book is open. The board is yours.

thinkle_host_promotion_1.text: Abracadabra! The pawn becomes something new.

thinkle_host_promotion_2.text: Ah, a promotion! A pawn no longer.

thinkle_host_promotion_3.text: The bravest pawn reached the far side!

thinkle_host_promotion_4.text: Hats off to that little pawn! Splendid!

thinkle_host_white_wins_1.text: White wins! A fine tale, told by you both.

thinkle_host_white_wins_2.text: Victory to White, and a bow to Black!

thinkle_host_white_wins_3.text: The stars smile on White, and wink at Black!

thinkle_host_white_wins_4.text: White wins, my friends. A warm bow to both players.

thinkle_host_white_wins_5.text: The victory goes to White. My thanks to Black as well.

thinkle_host_white_wins_6.text: White takes this game. A kind word for you both.

thinkle_host_win_1.text: And that is the last page. What a story!

thinkle_host_win_10.text: A winner, and two storytellers. Thank you for the game.

thinkle_host_win_2.text: The game is won! What splendid play, you two.

thinkle_host_win_3.text: My scrolls will remember this one. Bravo!

thinkle_host_win_4.text: The game is complete, my friends. Thank you, both of you.

thinkle_host_win_5.text: A winner is decided. A warm bow to each player.

thinkle_host_win_6.text: And here our little tale ends. My thanks to you both.

thinkle_host_win_7.text: The result is written. Do congratulate each other.

thinkle_host_win_8.text: One game for the book, and a kind word for both players.

thinkle_host_win_9.text: The final page, my friends. A bow before we close it.

thinkle_tutor_capture_done_1.text: Splendid! The dice chose the rook; you chose the target.

thinkle_tutor_capture_opening_1.text: Now for the fun part: taking pieces!

thinkle_tutor_capture_opening_2.text: Land on an enemy piece, and it leaves the board.

thinkle_tutor_capture_rolled_1.text: A rook, a queen and a bishop.

thinkle_tutor_capture_rolled_2.text: You have no queen or bishop here, so those dice go grey.

thinkle_tutor_capture_rolled_3.text: The rook will do nicely. See that black pawn?

thinkle_tutor_clear_done_1.text: All three used! Use every die you can: that is the rule.

thinkle_tutor_clear_moved_1.text: The way is open! Use the dice that are left.

thinkle_tutor_clear_opening_1.text: Sometimes a piece is stuck behind its own pawns.

thinkle_tutor_clear_opening_2.text: Then move a pawn first, and set it free!

thinkle_tutor_clear_rolled_1.text: A pawn, a bishop and a queen.

thinkle_tutor_clear_rolled_2.text: The bishop and queen are stuck, yet their dice are lit.

thinkle_tutor_clear_rolled_3.text: Only pawns that open the way glow. Move one first!

thinkle_tutor_closing_1.text: Castling, promotion and en passant use dice too.

thinkle_tutor_closing_2.text: Rules, on the home screen, has every detail.

thinkle_tutor_closing_3.text: May the stars and the dice be kind to you!

thinkle_tutor_dice_done_1.text: Well leapt! The grey dice go unused, and the turn ends.

thinkle_tutor_dice_opening_1.text: Now, a little secret of the dice.

thinkle_tutor_dice_opening_2.text: Each die shows a piece, and only that piece may move.

thinkle_tutor_dice_opening_3.text: Roll, and let us see what they choose.

thinkle_tutor_dice_rolled_1.text: Hmm... a queen, a bishop and a knight.

thinkle_tutor_dice_rolled_2.text: The queen and bishop are boxed in. Their dice go grey.

thinkle_tutor_dice_rolled_3.text: But a knight can leap over pieces!

thinkle_tutor_king_done_1.text: Victory! Taking the king wins at once.

thinkle_tutor_king_done_2.text: You may leave your king under attack. Guard him well!

thinkle_tutor_king_opening_1.text: Now, the most important rule of all.

thinkle_tutor_king_opening_2.text: Whoever takes the other king wins, there and then.

thinkle_tutor_king_rolled_1.text: A rook, and nothing between it and the king.

thinkle_tutor_missed_1.text: Not quite, my friend. Let us try that again.

thinkle_tutor_move_done_1.text: There! Three dice, three moves: your first turn.

thinkle_tutor_move_moved_1.text: Well done! Each die is one move. Use them all.

thinkle_tutor_move_opening_2.text: I am Thinkle, and I shall teach you Dice Chess.

thinkle_tutor_move_opening_3.text: Every turn begins with a roll of the dice.

thinkle_tutor_move_rolled_1.text: Three pawns! So your pawns may move, and they glow.

thinkle_tutor_move_rolled_2.text: Pick one, and the dots show where it may go.

thinkle_tutor_offer_2.text: I can teach you to play in a few minutes.

thinkle_tutor_pass_done_1.text: No harm done! At the start of a game, it happens often.

thinkle_tutor_pass_opening_1.text: Now and then, the dice play a little trick.

thinkle_tutor_pass_opening_2.text: Roll, and you will see what I mean.

thinkle_tutor_pass_rolled_1.text: Hmm... a queen, a rook and a king.

thinkle_tutor_pass_rolled_2.text: All three are boxed in, so every die goes grey.

thinkle_tutor_pass_rolled_3.text: When no die can be used, your turn simply passes.
